note: 장면별 그림 목록. id 가 곧 저장할 파일 이름(art/<id>.png). 내용은 영어로 적는다 (Gemini 프롬프트에 그대로 들어감). 화풍은 fairy/art/refe2.jpg (부드러운 3D 애니메이션풍 · 파스텔 · 반짝임) 참고. 먼저 cast(등장인물 시트)를 뽑아 얼굴을 고정하고, 이후 장면마다 refe2.jpg + cast.png 를 같이 첨부한다.
style: Drawing style (copy the look from the attached style reference image): a soft, adorable 3D-animated children's film look, like a high-quality cozy animated feature. Rounded, plush, toy-like shapes; big shiny expressive eyes with soft highlights; fluffy fur rendered with fine soft fibers; smooth glossy-matte materials (wood, ceramic, glass, candy). Pastel palette of pink, mint, baby blue, lavender, butter yellow and warm cream, with warm honey-wood tones. Warm cinematic lighting, soft glow from pastel pendant lamps, gentle bokeh, tiny sparkles and little stars floating in the air. Shallow depth of field, clean uncluttered composition, cozy and magical. Not photorealistic, not a flat 2D drawing, no harsh shadows.
ref: The attached style reference is ONLY for the look (3D animated pastel cozy-cafe feel, lighting, materials, sparkles). Do NOT copy its characters (the boy and the white cat), its composition, its text, or its exact props. Draw the new scene and the new animal characters described below, and keep each character's face, colors and outfit identical on every page (match the attached cast sheet if provided).
tail: Landscape 16:9, full frame with NO black bars or borders. Keep the bottom 15% calm and uncluttered (subtitles go there) and keep faces away from the very edges.
neg: No text, no letters, no numbers, no Korean or English signs, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no humans, no existing cartoon characters or mascots, no copy of the reference's boy or white cat, no realistic or scary animals, no horror, no extra fingers, no flat 2D crayon look, no photo-realism, no black letterbox bars.

characters.bara: BARA: a chubby, round, plush capybara who owns the cafe. Soft warm-brown fur with a lighter cream belly, small round ears, a big gentle nose, kind half-moon smiling eyes with soft highlights, tiny pink cheeks. Wears a cream apron with a small cup-and-heart pattern and a tiny pastel teacup brooch. Calm, slow, loving presence; always lowers herself to eye level with guests.
characters.sloth: SLOTH: a cute fluffy sloth with soft light-brown fur and a cream face with dark eye patches, big round wide eyes, a small gentle smile line. Splashed with muddy brown spots all over. Rides a bright orange kick scooter (later wears pastel inline skates).
characters.lion: LION: a big but shy young lion with a fluffy butter-yellow mane, round soft face, big droopy gentle eyes, tiny pink nose, rosy cheeks. Tail tucked between his legs when scared, tail up with a little tuft when happy. Plush and huggable, not fierce.
characters.hedgehog: DOCHI THE HEDGEHOG: a small round hedgehog with a cream face and tummy, soft warm-brown quills tipped with cream (quills stand straight up when angry, lie down fluffy and soft when calm), big dark shiny eyes, a tiny pink nose, rosy cheeks.
characters.chameleon: CHAMELEON: a small mint-green chameleon with a curly tail, big independent round eyes with soft highlights, a cute wide smile. His skin color shifts: swirling colors when confused, and in the end a beautiful rainbow-candy swirl pattern of pink, blue, yellow and mint.
characters.rabbit: RABBIT: a young light-gray-and-white rabbit with long soft ears (one slightly droopy), small pink nose, big shiny eyes that can fill with tears, wears a little red scarf with tiny apple patterns.
characters.squirrels: SQUIRRELS: tiny orange-brown squirrels with huge fluffy tails and big round eyes, trembling at first and cheerful later, all drawn in the same plush style.
characters.friends: ANIMAL FRIENDS: a small plush brown bear, a tiny pink-nosed mole with little glasses-like round eye marks, and small round blue-and-white birds, all in the same plush style and pastel palette.
characters.cafe: THE CAFE: a round, cozy wooden treehouse-like cafe interior with warm honey wood, a curved wooden counter, pastel pendant lamps (pink and teal), shelves with glass jars of star-shaped candies, a blank chalkboard menu with no writing, a round window showing green forest, a pink arched door with a round window and a small brass bell, little star garlands.
characters.machine: THE HEART-EXCHANGE MACHINE (마음환전기계): a charming pastel retro candy-machine, rounded teal-and-cream body with a big friendly round dial, little brass pipes, small blinking star lights, a coin slot on top and a glowing output tray at the bottom that sparkles when it works. It shakes and puffs tiny stars when running.

scenes.bg: soft warm cream with faint pastel sparkles
scenes.desc: CHARACTER SHEET (not a story scene): all the characters standing in one neat line on a plain soft cream background, full body, facing the viewer, evenly spaced so each is clearly visible and identical in design to the descriptions: Bara the capybara in the center (largest), then the sloth, lion, hedgehog, chameleon and rabbit, with two squirrels, a bear, a mole and a small bird in front.
scenes.comp: Wide lineup, plain background, no cafe, no props except Bara's apron. Use this image as the cast reference for every later page.

scenes.bg: warm honey-cream with pastel pink and teal glow
scenes.desc: Book cover. Inside the cozy cafe, BARA stands behind the wooden counter smiling warmly with open arms. In front of the counter the sloth, lion, hedgehog, chameleon and rabbit wave happily, each holding a small sweet treat (rainbow juice, popcorn, cotton-candy parfait, swirl lollipop, fruit punch). Glowing jars of star candies, sparkles in the air.
scenes.comp: Wide shot, symmetrical and welcoming. Leave the upper-center area calm and empty for the book title (do not draw any text).

scenes.bg: soft golden afternoon with pastel pink and teal glow
scenes.desc: Outside view of the magical cafe: a round cozy wooden cottage built around a big tree in a green forest, a pink arched door, round windows glowing warm yellow, a small chimney with a heart-shaped puff of smoke, pastel bunting of little stars, a sign shaped like a cup with a heart (no writing). A path of little glowing golden coins leads to the door. Tiny sparkles drift in the air.
scenes.comp: Wide establishing shot, slightly low angle, the cafe centered, forest softly blurred around it.

scenes.bg: warm honey-cream with pink glow
scenes.desc: BARA stands at the open pink arched door of the cafe, gently ringing a small brass bell above it with a happy, welcoming smile; little musical sparkles come out of the bell. Warm light spills out of the door behind her.
scenes.comp: Medium shot at Bara's eye level, door at the right, inviting and kind.

scenes.bg: bright green forest path with warm sunlight, a little frantic energy
scenes.desc: A muddy SLOTH zooms toward the cafe on a bright orange kick scooter at full speed with a wild, frazzled expression and open mouth as if shouting, mud splatters flying, motion lines and little dust puffs behind him. The cafe is visible at the left. The funny contrast of a sloth going super fast.
scenes.comp: Wide shot with movement from right to left, sloth in the foreground, cafe softly blurred behind.

scenes.bg: soft warm cream and pink, calm and gentle
scenes.desc: Inside the cafe BARA lowers herself to the same eye level as the muddy SLOTH and listens kindly, looking straight into his eyes with a soft sympathetic smile, one paw gently touching his arm. The sloth, still a bit muddy, looks sad and worn out, shoulders drooping, eyes a little teary. The scooter leans against the counter.
scenes.comp: Medium two-shot at eye level, close and tender, soft bokeh cafe lights behind.

scenes.bg: warm teal and lavender glow with magic sparkles
scenes.desc: BARA smiles and hands the sloth a golden coin with a little hourglass emblem. In the next beat the coin goes into the glowing HEART-EXCHANGE MACHINE, which shakes with noisy cheerful energy, puffing tiny stars; at the output tray a rainbow ribbon, seven ice cubes, a pile of sugar and a splash of water come out sparkling.
scenes.comp: Medium shot with the machine large at the right, hourglass coin in the foreground hand, magical and fun.

scenes.bg: soft lavender and pastel pink with warm lamplight
scenes.desc: BARA hums happily, pouring water over seven ice cubes into a big clear glass at the counter. The sloth watches eagerly with his chin on the counter. Through the glass the ice cubes slowly begin to melt, and thin streaks of rainbow color appear. Musical notes float above Bara.
scenes.comp: Medium-close shot over the counter, the glass with ice in the foreground, Bara and the sloth behind.

scenes.bg: warm orange and red glow, a bit antsy
scenes.desc: Close-up of a tall glass of juice that shows only two colors so far, red and orange, with five ice cubes still floating. The impatient SLOTH hops up and down beside it, hands clasped, eyes huge and sparkling, a bead of nervous sweat on his forehead, tongue almost sticking out, desperate to drink it.
scenes.comp: Close-up, the glass in the right foreground in focus, the fidgeting sloth at the left, comical.

scenes.bg: bright rainbow pastel glow with sparkles
scenes.desc: The SLOTH happily drinks a glass of seven-color rainbow juice (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet layers), eyes closed in bliss, both cheeks glowing pink, cute and proud that he waited. A small rainbow and sparkles float above the glass. Bara smiles in the soft-focus background.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, the sloth fills the left and center, rainbow glass in his hands, joyful.

scenes.bg: cool dusty blue and lavender, a little lonely but still cozy
scenes.desc: A big fluffy LION hides behind a thick wooden pillar inside the cafe, only half of his round face and his mane peeking out, body curled up small, tail tucked between his legs, big sad droopy eyes with a tiny tear, whispering. Bara sits calmly in the soft-focus distance by the counter, waiting kindly.
scenes.comp: Medium-long shot, the pillar and lion on the right third, empty cozy space on the left, gentle loneliness.

scenes.bg: warm golden butter-yellow glow with sparkles
scenes.desc: BARA gently hands the shy LION a golden coin with a little corn emblem, looking him in the eye with a warm smile. The lion drops the coin into the HEART-EXCHANGE MACHINE, which shakes happily; fresh corn kernels, a pinch of salt and a pat of butter tumble into the glowing tray with tiny stars.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, Bara and lion at the left, machine at the right, corn coin in a close-up paw.

scenes.bg: warm buttery yellow with soft glow
scenes.desc: BARA hums and presents a big paper cup of fluffy, steaming popcorn to the LION, who holds it with both paws, eyes wide and a tiny hopeful smile. A few popcorn pieces pop and sparkle in the air. Small musical notes float around Bara.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, the popcorn cup in the foreground, Bara and lion face to face, warm and encouraging.

scenes.bg: fresh light green and warm yellow, outside the cafe door
scenes.desc: Outside the cafe door the shy LION nervously holds out a handful of popcorn to two tiny SQUIRRELS passing by. The squirrels tremble, ears flat, eyes wide, tails puffed up, but reach out slowly. The lion's tail is still half tucked, a brave little blush on his cheeks.
scenes.comp: Wide shot with the lion at the left and the two squirrels at the right, a nervous tender moment.

scenes.bg: bright joyful yellow-green and pink, sunny
scenes.desc: Ten happy SQUIRRELS now gather around the smiling LION, munching popcorn, while three small round birds perch on his mane and above his head. The lion beams, tail high with a fluffy tuft, holding a bucket of popcorn that keeps popping and overflowing with tiny sparkles. Popcorn pieces float like confetti.
scenes.comp: Medium-wide shot, the lion at the center with squirrels all around, joyful burst.

scenes.bg: warm muted red-orange and dusty rose, tense
scenes.desc: A small HEDGEHOG stomps into the cafe through the pink door with all his quills standing straight up, fists clenched, cheeks puffed and red, eyes shiny with tears of unfairness, tiny steam puffs and angry zigzag marks above his head. Warm cafe light behind him.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, the hedgehog large in the center, door open behind him, emotional but cute, not scary.

scenes.bg: soft dusk lavender and gray-pink, quiet
scenes.desc: BARA listens, sitting at the hedgehog's level with warm sympathetic eyes. The HEDGEHOG looks up shyly, glancing sideways, quills slightly lower, hands tucked near his chest, asking if his bad feelings are allowed. A small thought-cloud sparkles above him.
scenes.comp: Medium two-shot with a slow focus on the hedgehog's worried upward gaze, quiet and delicate.

scenes.bg: soft sky blue and pink, hopeful warm light
scenes.desc: BARA kindly places a golden coin with a little cloud emblem in the hedgehog's hands and smiles, saying there are no bad feelings. In the background the HEART-EXCHANGE MACHINE runs and puffs tiny stars; at the tray fluffy cotton candy, colorful jellies, wafer sticks and heart sprinkles appear.
scenes.comp: Medium shot, Bara and hedgehog at the left, the sparkling machine tray at the right, a turning point of warmth and relief.

scenes.bg: dreamy pink and baby blue, soft fluffy glow
scenes.desc: The HEDGEHOG lies relaxed on a big fluffy cotton-candy cloud, eating a tall cotton-candy parfait with heart sprinkles, his quills lying down soft and flat, eyes half-closed in comfort and a sleepy happy smile, rosy cheeks. BARA smiles next to him, having just served the parfait. Hearts and tiny stars drift in the air.
scenes.comp: Medium-wide shot, the cloud and hedgehog in the foreground center, dreamy and soothing.

scenes.bg: swirling mint, purple, orange and pink colors, a bit dizzy
scenes.desc: A small CHAMELEON stands at the counter with his whole body swirling in a dizzy mix of colors (mint, purple, orange, pink spirals), eyes wandering in two directions, half hiding behind his curly tail while peeking out excitedly. Small question marks, hearts and tiny sparkles float around him.
scenes.comp: Close-up to medium, the chameleon fills the frame, the swirling skin colors are the focus.

scenes.bg: soft peach and warm cream, comforting
scenes.desc: BARA sits next to the CHAMELEON and gently explains with a kind smile, then offers him a golden coin with a little swirl emblem. The chameleon's color is calmer now, soft pastel patches. Warm lamp light and soft bokeh behind them.
scenes.comp: Medium two-shot at eye level, the swirl coin in the foreground, reassuring and quiet.

scenes.bg: bright candy pastel pink, blue and mint, sparkling
scenes.desc: From the HEART-EXCHANGE MACHINE tray come little bottles of colored pigment, fruit, sugar, a ribbon and a wooden stick, all sparkling. BARA hums as she twirls them into a giant colorful swirl lollipop, and hands it to the CHAMELEON with a warm smile. Sparkles and tiny stars fill the air.
scenes.comp: Medium shot with the machine tray in the foreground left and Bara handing the lollipop at the right.

scenes.bg: warm rainbow pastel pink and yellow, happy glow
scenes.desc: The CHAMELEON beams with delight holding a large swirl lollipop whose pink, blue, yellow and mint spiral exactly matches the beautiful rainbow-swirl pattern now on his own body, eyes sparkling, tongue licking the candy, cheeks glowing. Sparkles and little stars around him.
scenes.comp: Medium close-up, the chameleon and lollipop in the center, joyful self-acceptance.

scenes.bg: cool dusky blue and gray, a bit lonely
scenes.desc: Outside, a little RABBIT stands in front of the closed pink door of the cafe looking up at a small wooden sign hanging on it (a cute drawing of a sun and a beach umbrella, no text), big tears rolling down her cheeks, ears drooping, small paws rubbing her eyes. The windows are dark, the bell is still.
scenes.comp: Medium shot from behind the rabbit's side, the sign and closed door visible, quiet sadness but cute.

scenes.bg: warm golden light spilling out the door, hopeful
scenes.desc: The cafe door swings open with golden light. The LION stands in the doorway with a kind welcoming smile, the CHAMELEON and the HEDGEHOG sitting on his shoulders, and the SLOTH standing beside him smiling. The little RABBIT in the foreground looks up in happy surprise, tears still on her cheeks.
scenes.comp: Medium shot from the rabbit's side looking into the lit doorway, friends framed by the door.

scenes.bg: warm bustling pastel pink, yellow and teal
scenes.desc: In the middle of the cafe sits a huge glass bowl of colorful fruit punch (watermelon, strawberries, apples, little star fruit, pastel jelly cubes). The SLOTH glides in on pastel inline skates serving cups, the CHAMELEON proudly points at the bowl, and the happy RABBIT eats a bite of apple. A bear, squirrels, a mole and small birds enjoy the punch together, everyone laughing.
scenes.comp: Wide shot, the punch bowl in the center of the cafe, animals all around, festive and heartwarming.

scenes.bg: soft evening gold and rose, cozy
scenes.desc: All the animal friends sit in a cozy circle around the punch bowl with spoons, softly smiling and glancing toward the pink door, missing Bara. A warm evening glow comes through the round window and the pendant lamps are lit.
scenes.comp: Wide shot looking slightly down into the circle, cozy and slightly longing.

scenes.bg: warm golden glow with sparkles and a few soft stars
scenes.desc: BARA stands in the open doorway with a little suitcase beside her, a hand over her heart, big happy tears streaming down her cheeks as she looks at the big bowl of punch the animals made, a deeply touched and loving expression. Warm golden sparkles around her.
scenes.comp: Medium shot with the punch bowl in the soft-focus foreground and Bara in the doorway, emotional climax of the book.

scenes.bg: bright warm sunset gold, pink and teal, festive
scenes.desc: Everyone stands together in front of the cafe door waving goodbye at the viewer: BARA in the middle with a mischievous little finger to her lips (a secret!), the sloth, lion, hedgehog, chameleon, rabbit, squirrels, bear, mole and birds all smiling and waving. Little stars and hearts float in the warm air; the cafe glows behind them.
scenes.comp: Wide group shot at the cafe door, symmetrical, a warm happy ending.
